capabilities: Convert pasted web and AI LaTeX to $...$ and $$...$$
Paste Canvas cards into notes or other cards
Select line then whole note with Ctrl+A
disambiguation: Not a wiki-link or wiki-markup tool; it fixes pasting of math and Canvas cards plus editor shortcuts.
extras: Three opt-in experimental options are off by default: escaping pasted Markdown syntax, a Word-style paste options popup, and pasting web content as raw HTML. Issue reporting from inside Obsidian pre-fills version, platform, and enabled options.
problem: Pasting rendered equations or AI-chat math into Obsidian breaks symbols, duplicates text, or escapes dollar signs.
summary: Paste-handling plugin that converts web and AI-chat LaTeX into Obsidian math, expands Canvas cards, and adds editor shortcuts.
